narr: Evening thunderstorms developed primarily in Tennessee near a stationary boundary, with one storm deviating northward through Calloway County, Kentucky. This storm produced several reports of wind damage and resulted in a water rescue being needed in Murray as torrential rain induced flash flooding. MLCAPE was around 1000 J/kg and effective bulk shear was very limited, while PWs were near 1.8 inch.
ev: Flash flooding occurred in Murray with a water rescue for one person trapped in a vehicle on N 16th St. Radar estimated rainfall totals were 1.5-2.5 inches, most of which fell between 1945-2030CST.
lsr: Water rescue on going North 16th Street. 1 person is trapped.
